title: refactor(metadata-protocol): generate the protocol.ts section split with a deterministic codemod
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB7J3TmFTYMYQrfpye6GQNg9)_

Part of #29985

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：codemod `scripts/codemod-split-protocol.mjs` 按裁决 6624345766（门面形态，方案 A）生成 `protocol.ts` 的拆分。`ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` 成为门面：85 个成员各留一行委派，方法体移入 10 个无状态 facet 类（`<Module>Facet`，静态方法，首参是 host）；私有成员的文档块随方法体移走（54 个），公开成员的文档块留在门面；只读参数的私有静态方法也移出（7 个）。状态全部留在门面。生成文件未手改。
- 为什么改：#29465 大文件拆分；裁决 6624258595 把目标改为门面形态，6624345766 把 `.d.ts` 门槛改为「公开面相等」。
- 风险与回滚：纯搬移。85/85 方法体逐字节还原；`--verify` 先把门面形态逆提回 (a) 的模块形态，再逆推出 base 的 `protocol.ts` 和 `protocol-host.ts` 逐字节相同。公开面 `.d.ts` 相等（对照抓到）。测试 base 22,346 → head 22,347（+1 条非空检查）。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：① 「门面读数」一节的例外清单（#30019 门禁的初始白名单）；② codemod 的 `lift` / `unlift`；③ `check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs` 对 `<X>Facet.fn(...)` 存根的跟随和 3 条自测。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` 后运行 `node scripts/codemod-split-protocol.mjs --verify --base eee41490`，预期 `85/85 moved bodies restore to the base body exactly`、`23135 -> 13647 lines`，退出码 0；`--self-test` 55 例通过。
- 需要你做的：超过 3,000 行，需您批准，并在您定的窗口冻结 `protocol.ts` 后落地；本 PR 保持草稿。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- **`scripts/codemod-split-protocol.mjs`**, three additions over the module form PR #29998 had before:
  - **The facade layer** (`lift`, ruling 6624345766). Each section module's functions become the static methods of one stateless facet class, `<Module>Facet` (`protocol-save.ts` → `ProtocolSaveFacet`). A method still takes the host as its first parameter, so its body is the E1 body re-indented back to the class's depth. A facet holds no state: every field stays on the class and is read through the host. Each stub on the class calls `<Facet>.<member>(…)`.
  - **Docblock ownership.** A private member's docblock moves verbatim onto its facet method, and the class keeps one line: `/** Docblock and body: {@link <Facet>.<member>} in \`<file>\` [#29985 codemod]. */`. A public member's docblock stays on the facade, as the ruling requires, so the published `.d.ts` and consumers' hover text are unchanged.
  - **Private-static-through-host.** A private static whose body reads nothing of the class (no `this`, `super`, `arguments` or class name) moves to its section's facet with no host parameter. The class keeps the delegation, so moved instance bodies still reach it as `host.<static>`.
  - The pilot's `no-yield` rule (a body no longer than its stub stays) is dropped: under the facade rule the class keeps delegations only.
  - **The proof of the layer is its inverse** (`unlift`). `--verify` reads the head alone, turns it back into the module form, and refuses anything the lift would not have written: a public docblock moved, a stub calling another facet, a facet member that is not a static method, a body line the lift did not indent. It then runs every earlier proof on that module form, `host-split.mjs`'s `checkMove` included.
  - `--self-test`: 55 cases in 7 pinned batteries (a new `facade layer` battery of 10).
- **The generated split** is `--write` on `main` `eee41490`, unedited. Its modules are `protocol-class-head.ts`, `protocol-discovery-and-bases.ts`, `protocol-data-crud.ts` (new), `protocol-search-and-cache.ts`, `protocol-write-gates.ts`, `protocol-registry-hydration.ts`, `protocol-save.ts`, `protocol-history-and-publish.ts`, `protocol-package-commits.ts` and `protocol-diff-delete-load.ts`. Nothing re-exports them.
- **Readers widened** (ruling 6597555122 point 3) to the facet form:
  - `register-item`, `lookup-artifact-item` and `view-expansion-reconcile` census headers accept a facet's `static` member.
  - `read-verb-canonical-fold` follows `<Facet>.<fn>` stubs.
  - The receive-path test reads `applyRemoteMetadataMutation` as a static method.
  - Two newly moved members are re-keyed: `isShippedByAnotherPackage` gets a `file` row. `anotherPackageShips` is read as its delegation plus its facet body.
- **`scripts/check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs`**: a `<X>Facet.fn(protocolHost(this), …)` stub, or a private static's `<X>Facet.fn(…)`, is followed into the facet's static method. Without that, 3 read seams left the census (102 → 99). There are three new self-test rows, and the read-seam floor goes 70 → 73.

## Verification

| Reading | Base `eee41490` | Head |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `protocol.ts` lines | 23,135 | **13,647** |
| Byte-identity | | 85/85 bodies; `checkMove` 78/78 instance (statics compared directly); the unlift, then the undo, rebuilds both base files |
| Determinism | | output tree sha256 `85bbdf726e8fbb750229627f744bb152aa79fcfa02d95b939885bbdf3430fe92` on two runs; regeneration reproduces the committed tree |
| `metadata-protocol` `typecheck` | exit 0 | exit 0 |
| `metadata-protocol` `test` | 312 files, 22,346 passed, 26 skipped | 312 files, 22,347 passed, 26 skipped |
| `check:durability-log-level` | 51 seams (9 propagating), 102 read seams (13 discriminated) | the same, and the output is byte-identical |
| core / objectql / spec `test:repo`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm build` | | core 94, objectql 5, spec 1,539 passed; lint exit 0; build exit 0 |
| `dispatch-gates --commands` (73) | | 73 derived, 73 run, every exit 0; `--ran`: 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN |

### `.d.ts`: ruling 6624345766 item 1, "public surface EQUAL"

The reading is `dts-public.mjs`, in the project files at `issue-29985/dts-public.mjs`, sha256 `211b32062250606e658acd7fb8880e0079b4043121fb7b970c658b4b57bf5020`. It is dtsnorm (6441032442 B) with one step added first: every private class member, together with its docblock, is cut from both texts. Everything else must then be equal statement for statement, which is stricter than item 1.

| Reading | `index.d.ts` | `index.d.cts` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| raw | differs (private docblocks, and one union order) | differs (the same) |
| private members cut, union order, second normalisation | **equal** | **equal** |
| declared surface | equal | equal |

- The control that edits one public docblock is caught.
- The control that drops one private member passes.
- The facet classes do not appear in the `.d.ts`.
- 6441032442 B as written reads DIFFER, from the private docblocks only. That is what the ruling allows.

### Facade reading (the #30019 gate's starting allow-list)

- **85 members** delegate to 10 facets:

  | Facet | Members | Docblocks moved |
  |:--|--:|--:|
  | ClassHead | 17 | 7 |
  | DiscoveryAndBases | 12 | 6 |
  | DataCrud | 1 | 1 |
  | SearchAndCache | 1 | 0 |
  | WriteGates | 18 | 17 |
  | RegistryHydration | 14 | 14 |
  | Save | 4 | 3 |
  | HistoryAndPublish | 5 | 3 |
  | PackageCommits | 9 | 2 |
  | DiffDeleteLoad | 4 | 1 |

- **190 hand-series delegations** in their own forms: `.call(host, …)` 162, plain 12, `protocolHost(this)` 16. Their docblocks stay on the class, because their modules are the hand series' and are not facets.
- **26 methods with a body stay** as named exceptions, plus the constructor (15 lines) and the static block (the host factory, 203 lines):
  - **`inferred-return-type`** (a public type the `.d.ts` would re-infer): `getDiscovery` 460 lines, `findData` 751, `getData` 75, `cloneData` 105, and `saveMetaItem`, `publishMetaItem`, `rollbackMetaItem`, `deleteMetaItem` at 7 lines each.
  - **`closed-set`** (outside E1's rewrite set): `publishPackageDrafts` 993 lines (a bare `this`), `reconcileViewExpansions` 53, `packagelessOverlayWriteRefusal` 14, `namedBaseOverlayWriteRefusal` 12.
  - **`static-reads-class`**: `mergesOverlayAtRead`, `registryAllowsOverlay`, `isOverlayAllowed`, `isRuntimeCreateAllowed`, `codeOnlySourceHint`, `codeOnlyCreateError`, `codeOnlyOverrideError`, `refuseOrganizationScopedWrite`, `overlayPackageMismatchError`.
  - **`no-host-read`**: `rethrowUnlessMetadataStoreUnprovisioned`, `triggerAutomation`.
  - **`name-taken`**: `objectExtensionItemRefusal`.
  - **`host-entry-predicate`**: `packagedBaseRefusal`.
  - **`static-shape`** (public static): `resetEnvWritableCache`.

### Ablations

- The facade battery's public-docblock case goes red when `unlift`'s public-docblock check is removed.
- The durability gate's two facet rows go red when the facet branch is removed, and the census drops to 99.
- The facade battery also checks that a one-character edit in a moved docblock, a stub calling another facet, an extra facet member and an unindented body line each fail.

### Findings outside this PR

`protocol-packageless-overlay-migration.ts` is #30000; it is unchanged here.
